# National statistic: statistics-series (NSTAT)

One Statistics Canada series by vector: the latest value, the change on the period and the year, the history. One row per national statistic, keyed by SERIES_ID. Read by the **national-statistics** pack's connector `statistics-store` (table `<root>/statistics/statistics-series/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/national-statistics/samples/statistics-series.jsonl`, 7 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/national-statistics/samples/statistics-series.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `SERIES_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `VECTOR`, `TITLE`, `TABLE_ID`, `TOPIC`, `UNIT`, `LATEST`, `LATEST_PERIOD`, `CHANGE_PCT`, `YEAR_ON_YEAR_PCT`, `RELEASED` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CHANGE` | number | optional (filled in every row) | The latest value less the previous one. | unit: the record's UNIT | `80343.0` |
| `CHANGE_PCT` | number | optional (filled in every row) | The change on the period in per cent. | unit: % | `0.1926` |
| `FREQUENCY` | string | optional (filled in every row) | How often the series is published (Statistics Canada's frequency code, or the feed's YAML when it says). | seen: `monthly`, `daily`, `quarterly` | `"quarterly"` |
| `GEOGRAPHY` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The series' first member: its geography. | — | `"Canada"` |
| `HISTORY` | array of objects | required | The value by reference period, oldest first, over the feed's history-periods (PERIOD, VALUE). | — | [23 objects] |
| `HISTORY[].PERIOD` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The reference period (its first day). | — | `"2021-01-01"` |
| `HISTORY[].VALUE` | number | required | The published value for that period. | unit: the record's UNIT | `38058291.0` |
| `LATEST` | number | required | The latest published value, in the unit and scale shown. | unit: the record's UNIT | `41798407.0` |
| `LATEST_PERIOD` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The reference period of the latest value (its first day). | — | `"2026-07-01"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The series' title in the feed's YAML, as NAME for search. | — | `"Population of Canada"` |
| `PREVIOUS` | number | optional (filled in every row) | The value of the period before. | unit: the record's UNIT | `41718064.0` |
| `PREVIOUS_PERIOD` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every row) | The reference period of the previous value. | — | `"2026-04-01"` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | — | `"Source: Statistics Canada, <table>. Reproduced and distrib…` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The Statistics Canada table and vector the record was built from. | — | `"Statistics Canada table 17-10-0009-01, vector v1"` |
| `PROVENANCE.INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the source's terms forbid redistribution outside the organisation (Export data refuses the record). | — | `false` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The terms under which the source allows reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | — | `"Statistics Canada Open Licence"` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | — | `"2026-11-06"` |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The organisation whose published data the record holds. | — | `"Statistics Canada"` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The table's page on the Statistics Canada website. | — | `"https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=1710…` |
| `RELEASED` | timestamp (ISO-8601) | optional (filled in every row) | When Statistics Canada released the latest value (Eastern time). | — | `"2026-09-23T08:30"` |
| `SCALE` | string | required | The scalar factor the values carry (units, thousands, millions). | seen: `units`, `millions`, `thousands` | `"units"` |
| `SERIES_ID` | string | required | NSTAT-V and the Statistics Canada vector number. | pattern `^NSTAT-` | `"NSTAT-V1"` |
| `TABLE_ID` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The Statistics Canada table number (18-10-0004-01). | — | `"17-10-0009-01"` |
| `TABLE_TITLE` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The table's title in the feed's YAML. | — | `"Population estimates, quarterly"` |
| `TITLE` | string | required | The series' title in the feed's YAML. | — | `"Population of Canada"` |
| `TOPIC` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The theme the feed's YAML gives the series (Prices, Labour, Output, Population, Housing, Money markets). | — | `"Population"` |
| `UNIT` | string | required | What the value measures, from the feed's YAML (an index, %, CAD, persons, units). | — | `"persons"` |
| `VECTOR` | string | required | The Statistics Canada vector id (v and a number): one series of one table. | — | `"v1"` |
| `YEAR_ON_YEAR_PCT` | number | optional (filled in 86% of rows) | The change on the same period a year before, in per cent; empty when the history is shorter. | unit: % | `0.4553` |

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `SERIES_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `SERIES_ID`, `NAME`, `VECTOR`, `TITLE`, `UNIT`, `SCALE`, `LATEST`, `LATEST_PERIOD`, `HISTORY`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields); every row of the test data also fills `CHANGE`, `CHANGE_PCT`, `FREQUENCY`, `GEOGRAPHY`, `PREVIOUS`, `PREVIOUS_PERIOD`, `RELEASED`, `TABLE_ID`, `TABLE_TITLE`, `TOPIC`.
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `SERIES_ID` per snapshot.
- `SERIES_ID` matches `^NSTAT-`.
